picks.headline: FDA approves Cogent's drug for rare stomach cancer
picks.blurb: The agency cleared the Cogent therapy for use alongside Pfizer's much older medicine Sutent.

picks.headline: FDA extends assessment of experimental Vertex kidney drug
picks.blurb: The agency is taking more time on the investigational medicine while the company answers questions about possible safety concerns.

picks.headline: Here are some health AI conversation starters for the holidays
picks.blurb: A weekly newsletter edition picks out health-AI stories suited to family-gathering talk over the holiday stretch.

picks.headline: Lifestyle revamp lifts cognitive test scores in Asia, too
picks.blurb: Early results from Singapore's SINGER study, shown at the CTAD meeting, tested whether lifestyle changes alone could improve memory and thinking scores in older adults at risk.

picks.headline: Telepathy for digital device control
picks.blurb: The company describes how trial participants use its implant to operate digital devices with their minds.

picks.headline: Contractile function maintains cardiomyocyte differentiation and inhibits cell cycle activity
picks.blurb: In human cardiac organoids, briefly halting heart-cell contraction reactivated the cell cycle in a reversible way, the authors report.

picks.headline: Neuralink gets FDA nod for pivotal ALS brain implant trial
picks.blurb: The company says the cleared LINK study is the first pivotal U.S. trial of an implantable brain-computer interface, and it will assess safety and effectiveness.

picks.headline: FDA clears DeepHealth AI for five-year breast cancer risk assessment
picks.blurb: The 510(k) clearance covers Mammo Risk, a tool that uses routine mammograms to estimate a woman's chance of developing breast cancer within five years.

picks.headline: AI screens chest X-rays for lung cancers hiding in plain sight: study
picks.blurb: Across 41 hospitals in four central European countries, a chest X-ray flagging system helped find over 200 previously undiagnosed lung cancers.
